title: Juicy Post-Workout Kenyan Semolina Ugali
description: A hearty, Ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly Kenyan semolina dish, perfect for post-workout recovery. Rich in complex carbohydrates and protein.
instructions: On a wooden board, combine semolina flour and salt.
Gradually add water to the flour mixture, stirring with a wooden spoon to form a smooth dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes pliable and smooth.
Heat oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger to the pan and sauté until fragrant.
Add chili pepper to the pan and sauté for another minute.
Add the dough to the pan and shape into a rectangular block.
Cook for 5 minutes on each side or until the ugali is golden brown and crispy.
Serve hot with your choice of accompaniments, garnished with fresh cilantro leaves and a squeeze of lemon juice.
For added flavor, you can add chopped herbs or spices to the dough before cooking.
